_doc: Copy this to ~/.omniseek/profile.json (or point OMNISEEK_PROFILE_PATH at it) and edit. With NO profile present the engine runs all-default = every registered source on (pre-profile behavior). This template is the recommended OPEN-SOURCE starting point: broad-default ON for benign sources, WALLED login-sources OFF (bring your own account), curator idle. The profile is a sparse delta over the shipped source pack: only write what you change. See README.md (Configure) and SECURITY.md.

sources._doc: default_enabled true = every source on unless subtracted. disable/enable are exact adapter names; an explicit enable beats every group/tier rule (most-specific wins).

groups._doc: Coarse subtraction by facet. disable_domains uses the facets.json domain vocab (papers/jobs/immigration/news/...); disable_regions uses region tokens (cn/sg/ca/hk/us/global); disable_stability one of stable/keyed/scrape/walled; disable_kinds one of lookup/stream/...

walled._doc: Login/CDP sources are OFF unless you set enabled=true AND opt in per source under bring_your_own. You bring your own account/session; the session/cookies live host-side (a CDP profile or ~/.omniseek/credentials), never in this file. Circumvention-class sources (access_tier=circumvention, e.g. ones that decrypt an encrypted response) are not in the public pack at all. CONSENT: setting enabled=true is your acknowledgment that you accept operator responsibility for using these sources within the law and each site's Terms of Service in your jurisdiction (see SECURITY.md). OmniSeek fetches as your own agent; off-by-default + this explicit opt-in IS the consent gate.

safety._doc: redline_denylist_extra entries are ADDITIVE to the engine baseline redlines (same shape: {id, severity, kind, value, reason}); the baseline always applies.

rate._doc: Optional overrides of the fetcher deadline/worker literals for a slower/faster host, e.g. broad_deadline_s, broad_deadline_fresh_s, explicit_deadline_s, search_workers. Omit to use the defaults.
